dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the anterior cephalic region and the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with minor asymmetrical disruptions in the posterior-right margin where the body meets the water surface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a low-intensity yellowish-grey tint across the median dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, diffuse light-grey clusters of low spatial frequency located primarily in the posterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the primary white skin and localized grey-toned patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, dark, high-contrast punctate marks visible on the mid-dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible central depression surrounding the blowhole and a subtle longitudinal indentation along the posterior-midline axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, thin, light-colored linear scar is visible along the central axis in the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
